title: A Survey of Retrieval-Augmented Generation
text: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) combines a parametric language model with a non-parametric retrieval component to ground outputs in external documents. This survey reviews chunking strategies, embedding models, and vector database design choices that affect retrieval precision and recall in production systems.

title: Topic Modeling at Scale with BERTopic
text: We present an evaluation of BERTopic for large-scale corpus analysis, comparing it against LDA and NMF on coherence and topic diversity metrics across five real-world datasets including news, scientific abstracts, and forum posts.

title: Este es un resumen en español
text: Este artículo presenta un resumen completamente en español sobre el modelado de temas y el análisis de sentimientos en grandes corpus de texto para sistemas de recuperación aumentada.

title: Sentiment Analysis for Scientific Discourse
text: Sentiment analysis is traditionally applied to product reviews and social media, but recent work extends it to scientific discourse, measuring hedging language, confidence, and rhetorical stance across ArXiv abstracts in computer science subfields such as cs.AI, cs.CL, and cs.LG.
